adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the Disqus import task to call `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)` for each thread (lib/tasks/disqus.thor). `import_remote` performs `open(url).read` (app/models/topic_embed.rb) with no timeout options and no exception handling; the call site in the loop also has no `begin/rescue`. Any network error (unreachable host, timeout, invalid response) would raise and terminate the entire import, preventing continuation with remaining threads—this is a real failure mode introduced by the diff.
